data.sub: Jay Mehta KKR ki 22.5% hissedari bechne ko taiyar

chat.say: Bhai 400M dollar se kitne naye player aayenge?
Pehle itne dollar ginna seekh le bhai!

data.asar: Dollar unke paas aayenge, tum bas match dekho
data.caption:
KKR fans ke liye aayi badi khabar! Jay Mehta apni hissedari bechne ki taiyari mein hain.

• American company khareedegi KKR ki 22.5% hissedari
• Jay Mehta 400 million dollar mein bechne ko taiyar
• IPL franchises ki valuation ab aasmaan chhu rahi hai

Itne zero sunke toh hamara normal calculator hi freeze ho gaya!

Apne us KKR fan dost ko tag karo jo har saal 'Ami KKR' chillata hai!
